item.title: Quantum X-Labs Advances Quantum Computing for Nuclear Particle Transport Prediction
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Quantum X Labs Inc. (Nasdaq: QXL) (“Quantum X” or the “Company”), an advanced technologies company, today announced that its subsidiary, Nuclear Quantum, has presented development in one of the nuclear industry’s current bottle necks. Quantum X Labs, through Nuclear Quantum, is focused on integrating quantum computing into computationally intensive simulations […]
